title: Subscription Issue – Not Restoring After Reinstall
body: Hello, I deleted the app and just reinstalled it, but for some reason my subscription is not reconnecting, even though it’s paid until February 2026. How can I restore it so the subscription works again?
author: Ninykin

title: Subscription
body:
Hi! I like the app in general, but I bought a subscription, deleted the app, restored it and the subscription is not active anymore 
the app developers are not responding either by mail or instagram to fix this problem
author: imsotata

title: Beautiful, simple, yet buggy
body:
I’ve chosen the app among ~10 habit trackers I’ve played with. Using premium. Really it’s the easiest pretty way to track your progress (yeah, that bar which goes up with your results:). But! I can not recommend it because it’s buggy .. but pricy.

One annoying bug is: on the main screen if you have a chain of ticked “done” events for a habit, sometimes, past check marks being shown as empty circles (“not dones”). And when you re-check the thing you already checked before - the whole line of checks being restored correctly. 

Dear devs, please fix the issue!
author: aka_shhh
